name: Evolution API WhatsApp AI Agent Bot

parameters.name: search_knowledge_base
parameters.description: Access the secure, business-aware Knowledge Gateway. Searches official company documentation, FAQs, warranties, policies, exam regulations, and clinical directories using hybrid semantic and lexical retrieval.

parameters.name: manage_calendar
parameters.description: Checks slot availability or schedules Google Calendar booking. Accepts action ('CHECK_AVAILABILITY' or 'CREATE_BOOKING'), date ('YYYY-MM-DD'), time ('HH:MM'), customerPhone, and pushName.

parameters.name: sync_crm
parameters.description: Upserts lead record in CRM database and updates stage. Accepts intent, bookingDate, bookingTime, customerPhone, pushName, messageText, and aiReply.

Centralized, business-aware Evolution Response Router (Phase 33). Guarantees responses originate from the correct configured WhatsApp instance (point-of-sale for POS_RETAIL, student-assistant for BISE_EDU, hospital-assistant for HOSP_HEALTH). Validates active database mapping, dynamically sets instance send endpoints and tokens, and executes automated retries.

parameters.name: query_business_data
parameters.description:
Centralized Secure Structured Data Gateway for verified parameterized database queries. Operates under least-privilege DB roles. Supported approved operations:
- POS Retail: get_product, check_inventory, get_price
- BISE Education: get_student_result, get_fees
- Hospital Healthcare: get_doctor_schedule, get_doctors_by_specialty, get_departments.
Arbitrary dynamic SQL and destructive commands are strictly prohibited.

parameters.name: action_gateway
parameters.description: Access the centralized, business-aware Action Gateway for all state-changing and external write actions. Executes approved operations: POS (create_order, update_order, cancel_order, record_payment, sync_crm); BISE (submit_verification_request, submit_service_application, track_service_application); Hospital (create_appointment, book_appointment, reschedule_appointment, cancel_appointment, manage_calendar); Shared (send_notification, call_external_api). Requires action name and validated parameters. Read-only queries are strictly rejected.
